name: smwpatches-overworld-border-plus-v1-2
title: Overworld Border Plus v1.2.2
description:
The overworld border is pretty limited to edit, especially because it's a fixed tilemap in comparison to e.g. the status bar, especially the super version. Because of that, I made this patch which enables you to edit at least the top and bottom part.

For a list with (in)compatible patches and codes and, check out this thread.

As always, the readme contains more information.

Request made by GreenHammerBro.

GHB changes:
-Added an HTML javascript document that displays the memory range, what tile correlates to what RAM.
-Patching now displays on the Asar console window the RAM range.
-Github.
-2019-12-19: now shows relative RAM address.
